name: Buy the dip (z-score entry on SPY)
hypothesis: Sharp dips below the recent average are overreactions- buying them and selling the recovery beats holding.
signal_rule: Buy the S&P 500 when it closes 1.5 standard deviations below its 20-day average; sell when it recovers to the average; hold cash otherwise.
plain_rule: When the market dips hard below its recent average, you buy. When it climbs back to normal, you sell and wait.
claimed_result: The internet's favourite strategy- every dip is a discount, and buying discounts must beat paying full price
paper_ref: Tested against the buy-the-dip folk strategy; mean-reversion framing per De Bondt & Thaler (1985), Does the Stock Market Overreact?, Journal of Finance
